issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other, Special Revenue Fund 15,689.94
issues.issue: The Special Revenue Fund's investment is 'STFIIT #2-Keno' 203,804.19 (p3; it equals that fund's line 27 investments), so this fund looks like a keno fund and its 'Other' receipts may be keno/lottery proceeds. The page does not say so directly, so 'other' with review is defensible. The fund's Miscellaneous disbursements 17,594.90 (disbursements[3]) have the same question.
